> **Run 1, 2026-11-01. Result: FAILED.** Published as it came out. The thresholds of A7 (regime) and A8

# E1: battery discrimination

Seeds: 2000, 2001, 2002, 2003, 2004. Placebo runs per case: 200.
Overall: **FAILED**.
